sources.title: Youth Overuse Injury Prevention
sources.summary: Overuse injuries are common in youth sports due to repetitive motion and insufficient recovery.
recommendations: Include at least 1--------2 rest days per week
Monitor pain lasting more than 48 hours

sources.title: Youth Physical Activity Guidelines
sources.summary: Children and adolescents should average 60 minutes of moderate-to-vigorous activity daily.
recommendations: Include muscle-strengthening activities at least 3 days per week

movementSignals.title: Knee Injury Risk During Landings
movementSignals.summary: High-impact and poorly controlled landings increase knee injury risk, especially under fatigue.
recommendations: Focus on knee tracking over toes

movementSignals.title: Balance and Ankle Injury Risk
movementSignals.summary: Poor single-leg stability increases ankle and knee injury risk.

movementSignals.title: Growth Plate Stress Risk
movementSignals.summary: High-impact and heavy loading during growth spurts increases risk of growth plate injuries.
recommendations: Avoid maximal loads during rapid growth phases

movementSignals.title: Running Volume Injury Risk
movementSignals.summary: Rapid increases in running volume increase overuse injury risk.

movementSignals.title: Asymmetry and Single-Leg Control
movementSignals.summary: Poor unilateral control increases lower limb injury risk.

movementSignals.title: Heat Illness Risk During Training
movementSignals.summary: High temperatures and humidity increase risk of heat exhaustion and heat stroke during intense training.
recommendations: Hydrate before, during, and after activity
Use shaded or indoor environments when possible
